## Behaviour
No flag means all four agents; flags (`--claude --codex --cursor --opencode`) select a subset. Output order is fixed claude, codex, cursor, opencode; each target file exists after install, and remove undoes every one including deleting the opencode plugin.

## Scenarios
- Default install: four `installed ...` lines in order and four files exist; rerun reports four `unchanged` lines; default remove undoes all. Prevents one agent silently skipped.
- Flag subset installs only the named agents (covered).

## Reference coverage
1 test (install all covers every agent and remove all undoes it).

## Qew today
Mostly covered (no flag installs all four idempotently and privately; flags select agents). Missing: output order assertion and the full remove-all assertion.
seen.title: Install and remove all agents with one default invocation and ordered output
